notes.title: Demo Now Available & Featured in Steam Next Fest June 2025
notes.content:
To all teachers working tirelessly on the educational frontlines of Gensokyo:

We’re excited to announce that "A Schoolhouse in Gensokyo" will be part of the June 2025 Steam Next Fest starting June 9 (PT)!
Our free demo is now available — come experience the charm of this unique school in the world of Gensokyo.
[hr][/hr]Demo Info
Playtime: 16 turns (~2–3 hours)

Features: Core course planning, student growth, basic upgrade systems

Languages: Simplified Chinese / Japanese 
[hr][/hr]Game Overview
Take on the role of Keine Kamishirasawa, a half-beast teacher running a small school in the Human Village.
This is a strategic course-building + school sim rooted in Gensokyo.

Key Features
[olist]
Strategic Class Planning: Place weekly courses to trigger combos

Character Interactions: Talk and gift to Gensokyo residents, unlock side events and items

Regional Influence: Lessons spread across regions, unlocking new stories and mechanics

Upgrade Paths: Invest in Neutral, Reformist, or Traditional teaching ideologies to shape your school's path and ending
